messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated KV cache paging and continuous-batching error rate detected (pct 95 latency spike + increased OOM reclaim). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-paging

Sasha: saw this on the dashboard 10m ago, paging rate jumped ~6x, latency SLOs breaching for a handful of clusters :grimace:

Dinesh: filing initial triage: looks like a recent config change to continuous_batch.window_ms rolled out 6 hours ago. Could be larger batches + colder KV leading to cache blowups. Pulling logs now.

Olivia: any customer traffic impact? CS Priya pinged — Acme is reporting tokenization errors and elevated 502s.

Customer Success - Priya: Acme support -> some requests are timing out and some users see partial responses. They've escalated to their SREs.

Sasha: confirmed Acme's requests correlate to the clusters with the highest paging. If we don't reduce pressure soon they'll see increased throttles.

oncall-sre: oncall here. Repeating triage: batch window increased from 8ms -> 50ms in the weekend deploy. That increases in-flight KV footprint. Block manager can't evict fast enough; paging thrash.

Dinesh: past few minutes of heap logs:
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:01Z] block_manager: free_blocks=120 used_blocks=980 peak_used=1500
[2026-03-15T09:13:02Z] kv_cache: cache_entries=2.1m memory=12.8GB paging_io=340/s
[2026-03-15T09:14:05Z] eviction: backlog=420 ops/s latency=120ms
```

Matt: propose immediate mitigation order: 1) roll back continuous_batch.window_ms to previous value, 2) reduce per-shard batch_limit temporarily, 3) force an eviction sweep on impacted hosts.

Sasha: agree. Rolling rollback via infra job now. Triggering job: redwood-deploy/rollback-batch-config -> job id 20260315-9982.

deploy-bot: Job queued: redwood-deploy/rollback-batch-config (20260315-9982). Initiated by Sasha. Status: started. See logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/20260315-9982

oncall-sre: while rollback runs, we should also apply a conservative block_size override for affected hosts to reduce thrash. Command to apply via remote-config:
```bash
rwctl config set runtime.block_manager.block_size_bytes 262144 --selector cluster=us-west-2-pool-3 --reason "emergency reduce thrash"
```

Olivia: I'm drafting an external incident update for Acme. Current customer impact: timeouts & partial responses for ~3% of their requests over last 25m. Will mention rollback in flight.

Dinesh: quick note: there's a metadata churn pattern in the logs too — block_metadata_update spikes when eviction fails. Could be small metadata leak that amplifies memory usage under this batching pattern. Logging a follow-up eval job.

Sasha: rollback job completed: deploy-bot: Job redwood-deploy/rollback-batch-config (20260315-9982) succeeded.

deploy-bot: Service restart scheduled for pool us-west-2-pool-3 to pick up config. Rolling restart window starting now. Status: 1/8 hosts restarted.

oncall-sre: after the restart we still see elevated IO but paging rate trending down (from 340/s -> 145/s). Latency p95 improved but not fully back to normal. Continuing to monitor.

Matt: I'm applying the temporary per-shard batch_limit change:
```json
{"continuous_batch": {"batch_limit": 64, "window_ms": 8}}
```
Applied to impacted namespace.

Dinesh: eviction sweep triggered across the pool. CLI output:
```
> rwctl runtime evict --selector cluster=us-west-2-pool-3 --force
Eviction started: sweep_id=evict-20260315-01
Estimated reclaimed: ~2.4GB
```

Customer Success - Priya: Sent update to Acme: rollback initiated, mitigations in progress, ETA ~30-45m for stabilization. They acknowledged.

Sasha: monitoring graphs show p50/p95 improving. I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth. If anything regresses, @oncall-sre escalate to SRE lead.

Dinesh: opened a follow-up bug: RED-3751 "paged-kv: metadata churn under large continuous batches -> investigation + long-term fix" with repro steps and logs attached.

oncall-sre: handing off to night SRE in 2h. Leaving runbook pointers and commands used. Please pick up if paging climbs again.

Olivia: putting a short incident summary in the incident tracker and will coordinate postmortem if impact persists.

Sasha: final note — consider adding a gating alert on continuous_batch.window_ms changes in CI so wide-valued rollouts get flagged automatically.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation actions executed (rollback + eviction + block_size override). Customer Acme notified. Monitoring for 60m.
